name: 60542 · North Aurora, IL
findings: ZIP 60542 (North Aurora) has 47 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 13 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60542 (North Aurora) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60542 (North Aurora) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 55% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
